title: 🏛️ Government Agricultural Schemes
subtitle: Explore government subsidies, financial aid, and insurance programs for farmers
advisoryNote: Visit the official government portals for latest updates. Keep your Aadhaar and land records ready to speed up your application.
pmKisanDesc: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to all farmer families in three equal installments of ₹2,000.
pmfbyDesc: Crop insurance scheme that provides financial support to farmers suffering crop loss due to natural calamities.
pmfbyBen: Up to full crop loss coverage
pmksyDesc: Ensures water to every field with mission 'Har Khet Ko Pani' and promotes water use efficiency via 'More Crop Per Drop'.
kccDesc: Provides adequate and timely credit support for farmers for their cultivation and non-farm activities.
shcDesc: Provides soil health cards to farmers with crop-wise recommendations for nutrients and fertilizers required.
nfsmDesc: Enhances production of rice, wheat, pulses and coarse cereals through area expansion and productivity enhancement.
